title: Chapter 573
paragraphs: Chapter 573
Episode 148. Sword Emperor (5)
Dante was convulsing. His black blood flowed down Jin's neck.
Jin clenched her teeth as she confirmed that the blood was tainted with chaos and turned pitch black.
Dante's body, touching her back, was cold and stiff.
Right after Ron and Jin had saved him, his pulse was weak but his body temperature had almost returned to normal.
Undoubtedly, Dante was dying.
How many trials had there been to save Dante?
Overcoming all of them and finally saving her friend, Jin couldn't afford to feel anger towards Gleak as she couldn't bear the thought of losing Dante so meaninglessly.
Her mind was only filled with the determination to save Dante.
Jin recalled the words Ron had said before they escaped Gleak's abyss.
He had told her to somehow escape with Dante while he fought the final battle against Gleak.
"I have to go to the rear battlefield and find Talaris!"
She had to ask Talaris if there was a sealing method that could delay Dante's death.
Not only her, but Jin also had to check with Rosa and Kelriak if they had any means to save Dante and obtain it. If they possessed the legacy of Numerus, Jin had to tell them to use it on Dante.
Under normal circumstances, they wouldn't use such a divine artifact to save Dante, but not now.
Since Ron had ascended to Changseong, even the great families had to save Dante in order to avoid his wrath.
"The chances of Runekandel and Zifley having the legacy of Numerus are slim. Even if they had it, they would have already used it given the current situation. Still, I have to head that way...!"
She desperately turned her head in all directions. No matter which way she looked, Gleak's chaos was blocking her path.
Jin followed the trail left by Ron's sword, stepping quickly toward any place where there might be a gap.
The formless sword energy continued to eliminate the chaotic energy, but there was no sign of enough space being created to escape.
Furthermore, during the time Ron swung his sword to open the path, there was inevitably a slight gap in Jin's safety.
The black claws of chaos were rushing into that gap.
Fortunately, it wasn't unavoidable yet, but it wouldn't be that way forever.
Ron detached a part of the energy that was protecting him and overlaid it on Jin and Dante.
Strictly speaking, Jin wasn't in battle with Gleak, and unlike Ron who had ascended to Changseong, she couldn't accurately read the flow of his attacks.
Therefore, Jin didn't know that the chaotic energies outside of her sight were also targeting her.
She only knew when a black spike flying from behind pierced the protective shield.
"Jin, don't dodge or block, just keep moving forward!"
Jin nodded her head. Every time the spike caused a crack in the shield that wrapped Jin, Ron sent his energy.
Just because one has the power to defy fate, it doesn't mean one can always do so.
Gleak's words were not a lie. Humans only gained the possibility of winning the fight thanks to Ron reaching Changseong, but they were not guaranteed victory.
Full power.
Gleak was literally pouring out all his power now.
And when the King of the Black Sea goes all out, it means that the repercussions of the battle are not confined to this place, the territory of Sword Emperor City.
Kwaaaaa...!
At the sudden sound that started, everyone on the battlefield, except Ron, reflexively looked up at the sky.
The sky, dyed black with chaos, was opening.
It was a crack forming at a level different from when the sky changed due to the magic stone.
Black lightning struck down through the swirling chaos.
Knights and magicians who were barely holding up against the merciless black lightning finally lost their lives, and deep holes were dug wherever the lightning struck.
Chaos erupted from within like lava. Amid the intensified disaster, the elites of Runekandel and Zifley were falling lifelessly.
And all of this was happening just within the territory of Sword Emperor City.
The sight of chaos flowing following the vortex spread in the sky could also be seen.

That chaos, moving beyond the battlefield, was heading towards the empire. Beyond the empire, to other places where people lived, to the territories of Runekandel and Zifley, at an incredibly fast speed.
'Is he planning to attack all of humanity?'

Even Rosa, who told Jin that it didn't matter if the whole world perished as long as Runekandel survived, was horrified to see chaos heading towards humanity. It was as if she had encountered a case more shocking than anything in her life.
It was chaos that not even the elites of each faction could withstand.
If such a thing is released indiscriminately into the world, ordinary humans absolutely can't handle it.
The destruction of the world is a foreseen order.
'Is there no choice but to hope that the prophet has prepared some countermeasures? Even though I don't know what she will ask for in return.'
Kelriak was also having similar thoughts to Rosa.
'If it continues like this, not only the empire will perish... Zifley is also in danger.'

The two families had already taken a tremendous blow. In Runcandel, even among the Black Knights, casualties had begun to appear, and Zephyr had nearly lost its fleet, and it was impossible to know how many dragons and wizards had died.
Fleets could be produced again, and dragons could be found and assimilated from those who had stopped their activities.
However, even if the warriors of Zephyr were revived with the Demon Stone, they could never return to their original state because the power was not yet complete.
Moreover, as Glyak began to exert all his power, the Demon Stone was again affected.
Until now, it had only trembled in fear, but now it is showing an unstable state as if it could run rampant at any moment.
'...Veradin, should I have not limited his rampage from the start? I can only hope that Kadun and Hedo can make the right decision without me.'
As Kinzel first predicted, Runcandel and Zephyr are not without a last resort.
However, it was a means that both families absolutely wanted to exclude. If they had known about Glyak from the beginning, it might have been different, but it was too late to bring it up now.
'The land where my daughter has to live... how on earth can I stop that.'
Talaris, who had been sitting down catching his breath, also lifted his head and looked at the sky with a lost face.
As giants, they had no means to stop the chaos that had begun to proliferate throughout the world. Glyak didn't say anything, but it felt like his sense of victory was penetrating to the bone.
However, their despair did not last long.
The next moment, they saw a gigantic protective wall that humans had never seen in their lifetime.
A huge hemispherical protective wall formed by light covered the entire battlefield and extended beyond the coast.
Protection, the characteristic of the creation achieved by Ron. That power, no. 'Authority' began to block the chaos released into the world in response to the chaos.
The area of the protective wall grew faster than the spread of Glyak's chaos.
It was a tremendous power that could not be believed to have been made by a human, it began to protect the entire world.
It's something not even the gods can do.
It was a protection that only Ron High could achieve.
"You said to beat you, I have nothing to protect."
As Ron said this and thrust his sword forward, Glyak's scattered chaos followed Ron's hand and formed a human-like figure in front of him.
It was not something Glyak had made, but something Ron had forcibly drawn out from the chaos. It was to create a state suitable for cutting and eliminating.
Squeak-!

When Rashid cut that figure, the entire space corrupted by chaos shook. The proliferation of chaos escaping from the vortex stopped for a moment, and Ron once again forcibly grabbed the energy of it as soon as that figure was dispersed.
"If it wasn't for that, I wouldn't have made it this far......"
Ron continued to cut through Glyak like that.

If Gliac had been dealing with Ciron, taking all of humanity hostage would have been a brilliant decision. Because Ciron might have been able to kill him faster than Ron, but he couldn't have prevented the ransom from being hit.
However, it was a clear mistake against Ron. Gliac should have focused all his energy on one person, Ron Hiran.
What Gliac did was not without calculation. He had hoped that his heart would accelerate when Dante died and the world was on the brink of extinction.
It's true that there is still a threat of becoming a monster for Ron.
However, the creation of Ron's protection reached a much greater area than what Gliac felt.
Ron's protective wall was not perfectly blocking all the chaos that was going out onto the battlefield.
Still, if the leakage was at this level, those left outside could handle it.
There would be damage, but it could completely rule out world destruction.
"No matter what you do, I will never become a monster like you. Even if Dante, my grandson, who I saved with so much difficulty, eventually meets death at your hands, never."
[We'll see.]
At that, Ron grinned, smiling.
"Do you think you can see it?"
Gliac did not answer.
Ugh!
Dante, who was riding on Jin's back, spit out another black blood clot.
The convulsions had completely ceased, but Jin could hardly feel his pulse.
Thanks to Ron's protective shield, Jin was far from Ron and Gliac's battlefield, but it still took time to reach Talalis, Rosa, and Kelliac.
It didn't seem like Dante could continue to survive inside.
Regardless of Dante's survival, Ron had clearly gained the upper hand.
Gliac was unable to prevent Ron from forcibly forming his body and cutting it because he had dispersed his power.
Every time Ron cut Gliac, the vibrations on the battlefield became more intense, and the amount of chaos leaking out of the protective wall also decreased.
For the first time, Gliac was cornered. Like a beast that never lets go of the neck it's holding, Ron was successfully pressuring Gliac.
Finally, those who were fighting outside also had some leeway. Rosa and Kelliac quickly ordered the injured to be moved to the part of the protective wall where the chaos was least.
And Gliac, leaving Dante to Jin alone... looking at Ron, who is only focusing on him, he suddenly got a strange feeling.
Ron's goal is clearly to save Dante.
Gliac thought that if so, the first thing Ron should do is not attack him, but share the energy of his creation with Dante.
[Ah.]
As if he had gained some certainty, Gliac voiced. The conclusion he came to was this.
[Ron Hiran... You're going to blow yourself up with me.]
